summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/modularpayments-webfields@1.0.56 declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then invokes `execFileSync("bun", [path.join(D, "math_init.js")],...)` to execute a bundled sibling file. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte single-line JavaScript blob using string-array rotation (top-level rotator function shifting a large mixed literal array), hex-named identifiers (`_0x...`), and a char-code decoder — an obfuscation shape that defeats automated inspection. Shipping an alternate JavaScript runtime specifically to run an opaque bundled payload at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the installer cannot see what the payload does before it runs, and Node-based scanners looking at the package do not evaluate what Bun executes. This is not the aggressive-but-legitimate pattern of installing an official runtime to run the package's own readable code — the payload here is deliberately unreadable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
